claim: В Gene Ontology releases/2026-07-26 термин GO:0071237 (cellular response to bacteriocin) относится к biological_process. Определение GO на языке источника: Any process that results in a change in state or activity of a cell (in terms of movement, secretion, enzyme production, gene expression, etc.) as a result of a bacteriocin stimulus.
